intermediate_data_gap_assessment.blocker_explanation: The public RSMS Angular dashboard only renders the latest approved bulletin as on 2026-10-29. Multi-week historical archive queries require authenticated credentials at https://rsms.cwc.gov.in/admin/login. The public static bulletin archive at cwc.gov.in ended weekly uploads on 2025-05-01.
intermediate_data_gap_assessment.epistemic_policy_compliance: Zero synthetic water records. EcoSite refuses to invent 77 unreleased intermediate weeks.

forecast_readiness_verdict.justification: While the origin state as of 2026-10-29 is officially verified (864.37 MCM, 91.76%), continuous weekly backtesting across 2025-2026 is blocked by the 77-week unreleased gap. Therefore, current post-monsoon 2026 outlook is provided as clearly labeled ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIOS anchored to the verified origin, NOT an unvalidated continuous statistical forecast.

scenarios_included: Dry Year Stressed Depletion (Accelerated Non-Monsoon Drawdown)
